A metal hemostat-style instrument at the upper left grips a thin strand at the wound edge and another metal instrument lies along the finger toward the lower center. A gloved hand is at the lower right. A purple ink cross is drawn on the skin below the incision and a purple ink line runs from the upper edge of the incision. Adjacent fingers and the thumb are visible on both sides. No text, labels, arrows or scale are visible.
